edge.title: Shampoo retune: pinv roots, ε=0, precond every step, β2 0.9, lr 0.01
edge.summary: Keeps #21's DistributedShampoo setup but retunes it: inverse roots now use a pseudo-inverse (EigenConfig with PseudoInverseConfig and epsilon=0.0, so non-positive eigenvalues are dropped and no damping is added) and are recomputed every step (precondition_frequency=1), with Shampoo active from step 1. β2 falls to 0.9 for both the Kronecker factors and the Adam graft (graft eps 1e-15), and lr/wd move to 0.01/0.1, cutting the steps needed from 4100 to 3375 (n=2). Short-memory, undamped factors refreshed every step make the preconditioner track the recent gradient geometry closely; the README's 'One-Sided' label is not visible in the logged config (see caveats).

changes.label: Pseudo-inverse roots, epsilon 0
changes.detail: preconditioner_config=RootInvShampooPreconditionerConfig(amortized_computation_config=EigenConfig(rank_deficient_stability_config=PseudoInverseConfig())) with epsilon=0.0: eigenvalues ≤ 0 (rank_atol=rank_rtol=0) map to 0, the rest to λ^-1/4; no ridge term (was ε=1e-12).

changes.label: precondition_frequency 5 → 1
changes.detail: Roots are recomputed every step; start_preconditioning_step=-1 now resolves to 1, so #21's Adam-only steps 1–4 disappear.

changes.label: β2 0.95 → 0.9; graft eps → 1e-15
changes.detail: shampoo_beta2 = 9e-1 feeds both betas[1] (factor EMAs) and the AdamPreconditionerConfig grafting second moment; grafting epsilon 1e-10 → 1e-15. β1 stays 0.9.

changes.label: lr 0.0015 → 0.01, wd 0.2 → 0.1
changes.detail: Decoupled decay per step at peak rises from 3e-4 to 1e-3.

changes.label: Steps 4150/4100 → 3375/3375
changes.detail: train_steps=3375; the result is taken at the final step (no early stop).

edge.parent_check: Consistent with #21 (same skeleton and library import; only the Shampoo config and step count change). However, the README's 'One-Sided Shampoo' is not reflected in the code: no inverse_exponent_override is set and both factor dims (768, 3072) are below max_preconditioner_dim=8192, so the distributed_shampoo copy vendored with #21 (and current upstream) applies −1/4 roots on both sides.

techniques.note: README: 'One-Sided'; code: -1/4 pinv roots both sides, pf=1, betas (0.9,0.9), lr 0.01, wd 0.1
proj weights zero (incl. LM head); all biases zero

hparams.init.hidden_std: normal, std 0.33**0.5 / fan_in**0.5 ≈ 0.0207 (q, k, v, mlp.fc)
hparams.init.proj: zero (attn.proj, mlp.proj and LM head weights)

caveats: README calls this 'One-Sided Shampoo', but the logged configuration (RootInvShampooPreconditionerConfig without inverse_exponent_override) gives two-sided L^-1/4·M·R^-1/4 under both the distributed_shampoo copy vendored with #21 and current upstream; one-sided preconditioning could only come from a modified library that is not in the log. Tagged 'shampoo' for that reason. Like #21 it imports the external library instead of inlining it. n=2 (3.27656, 3.27675) on 8×H200; no PR link.
